summary: First testing pass on EAT Portal (FastAPI + React + Mongo). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — covers magic-link auth (admin allowlist, single-use tokens, JWT, /me), rate-card values, family/athlete/session CRUD, attendance billing (full/half/drop-in, rate_override semantics, drop-ins NOT overridden, absent excluded), invoice generation with sequential EAT-NNNNNN numbering, PDF rendering (WeasyPrint returns real %PDF bytes), payment marks invoice paid, delete restricted to draft invoices, Resend send accepted as either 200 or 500 (returned 200 in this run). Frontend (mobile 390x844): /login renders, magic link flow shows dev link, /verify auto-authenticates and redirects to /, bottom-tab nav present, no horizontal overflow, Calendar 'New Session' modal opens, Roster create-family + create-athlete modals open and family was created end-to-end via UI, Invoices list page shows existing invoices and 'New Invoice' button, Settings displays full rate card ($60/$30/$85/$50/$300/$1100/$85/$65).

minor.issue: Resend domain currently sends 200, but if domain ever unverifies the route raises a raw 500 with the exception string; consider a more user-friendly error payload.
Only blocks deletion when athletes exist — does not check sessions/invoices referencing the family. Could leave orphan invoices if a family is deleted later.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation wrapping the family option label text in a <span>. Doesn't break the page but pollutes the console and may break SSR.

Console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on every modal (new session, new family, new athlete, invoice modals). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for a11y.

design_issues.screen: All forms with date pickers (SessionForm, AthleteForm, Invoice generate, Payment)
issues: Uses native browser <input type='date'> picker rather than shadcn calendar component as preferred per testing guidelines. Functional but inconsistent with rest of design system.

action_items: Optionally swap native <input type=date> for shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistent UX.
Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to all Modal components to silence Radix a11y warnings.

Fix AthleteForm <option> hydration warning — the dynamic visual-edit wrapper injects a <span> inside <option>; either disable VE instrumentation on that node or render the option text as a plain string (e.g., {`${f.family_name} (${f.guardian_name})`}).
Consider tightening DELETE /api/families to also block when sessions or invoices reference the family.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] at import time — fine, but JWT_EXP_DAYS=30 is long for an admin-only portal; consider 7 days or sliding refresh.
routes_sessions.save_attendance silently skips entries with unknown athlete_id (no warning logged) — could mask data bugs.
routes_invoices.send_invoice surfaces Resend exception text directly in the 500 response — fine for dev, but in prod the raw exception could leak Resend internals.

billing.compute_billed_rate: half-day with rate_override on full_time uses base/2 (override/2). For program_type=private/semi_private with half attendance + rate_override the formula also returns override/2 — confirm with product if half-day private should be 50% of override.
Mongo counters collection uses _id='invoice_seq' — atomic find_one_and_update with upsert is correct. Good.
No pagination on list endpoints (families/athletes/sessions/invoices) — fine for current scale (single coach) but flag for the future.
test_credentials: Admin: coachrico@eliteatmospheretraining.com — magic-link only (DEV_MODE returns dev_token & dev_magic_link in response).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed families/athletes/sessions/invoices. Some TEST_ data is left in Mongo because cleanup of invoices/sessions is partial; this is intentional for the next agent to inspect, and does not affect production logic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered comprehensively in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (15 tests, 100% pass via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Use mobile nav testids with '-mobile' suffix (e.g., nav-roster-mobile) — the desktop nav-* testids are hidden on mobile viewport. Resend domain noreply@eliteatmospheretraining.com appears verified — /api/invoices/{id}/send returned 200 in this run. Invoice number counter starts at EAT-000001 and increments across runs (not reset). Test family/athlete records remain in DB with TEST_ prefix.
